mentions.name: Syntopic reading machine
mentions.description: A side project that uses Claude to perform meta-analysis: writing blog posts that connect and derive concepts across a range of books, articles, and papers, effectively a syntopic reading machine.
mentions.source_excerpt: meta-analysis, make Claude write a blog post, connecting and deriving set of concepts across a range of books, articles, papers, etc. Basically a syntopic reading machine. Its a meaty side project (and expensive), but I am curious how close I can push this.
